basic_details.job_title: RGCB Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB) (RGCB) has announced 1 contractual vacancy for the Research Associate-I post under advertisement number 16/2026. Candidates applying for this position must possess a PhD in Life sciences with experience in embryonic stem cells/mammalian cell culture certified (thesis) and differentiation strategies of stem cells, and must be below 35 years of age as on 23 October 2026. The offered pay is Rs. 58,000 + 18% HRA per month for an initial tenure of four months or till termination of the project. Eligible applicants must submit their online applicatio

age_limit.details: Candidates must be below 35 years of age as on October 23rd, 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms.

qualification.details: PhD in Life sciences. experience in embryonic stem cells/mammalian cell culture certified (thesis), differentiation strategies of stem cells.

how_to_apply: Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel.
Ensure that completed applications are received on or before 23rd October 2026.
If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position.
important_instructions: Applications which are not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Only those fulfilling the above criteria need apply. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise). As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co terminus with end of the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Life sciences. experience in embryonic stem cells/mammalian cell culture certified (thesis), differentiation strategies of stem cells. Derivation of embryonic stem cells from embryo, embryo handling, teratoma generation, muscle stem cell differentiation, mouse handling, and other cellular and molecular biology associated experiences including western blot, RT-PCR, IF, FACS, IHC analysis. Candidates must be below 35 years of age as on October 23rd, 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of ₹ 58,000 + 18% HRA per month. The appointment is initially for a period of four months or till termination of the project whichever is earlier and extendable based on the performance evaluation.

content_sections.heading: RGCB Research Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Research Associate-I will work in the Laboratory of Dr. Debasree Dutta Scientist F, Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram under the DBT-BIRAC Project on ‘Smart Proteins’ for Fostering High Performance Biomanufacturing under the BioE3 Policy, entitled "Formulation of serum free growth media for the derivation and differentiation of bovine embryonic stem cells to muscle stem cells: a sustainable plant-based indigenous alternative for the production of cultured meat".

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Applications should be submitted online. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. Ensure that completed applications are received on or before 23rd October 2026. If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview.

As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co terminus with end of the project.
